projects.name: Finity Pay As You Go
projects.about: Finity is a pay-as-you-go fintech that lets people pay only for what they actually use. We built a brand and an app that earns trust from the first screen.
projects.challenge: Finity needed to look credible in a crowded fintech market right out of the gate. That meant a brand flexible enough for a payments product, and an app that makes flexible billing feel simple instead of confusing.
projects.solution: We built the full identity: a logomark, type, and a purple and lime system that stands out in fintech. Then we designed the app around one idea, you always know what you're paying for. Delivered in two weeks.

projects.name: Alfred
projects.scope: Brand, web & app design, web development
projects.about: Alfred is a LATAM fintech built for fast, simple money movement. We designed the brand, the website, and the app, and built the site. The platform now moves 12K transactions a month.
projects.challenge: Alfred was raising money and partnering with banks while still looking like a prototype. It needed a brand and product design that could win over regulators, banks, and everyday users all at once.
projects.solution: A clean wordmark with a directional arrow, a dark and confident visual system, and web and app interfaces built for trust and speed. It helped back a $1M investment from Stellar and more than 5 bank partnerships across LATAM.

projects.name: Eagle
projects.about: Eagle Partners needed an identity with the kind of authority its name promises. We designed the full brand: mark, typography, and color system.
projects.challenge: Sports style eagle logos are everywhere, and most of them look generic. Eagle Partners needed a mark that felt bold and established without falling into cliché.
projects.solution: We built the eagle head right into the wordmark itself, the G becomes the bird, over a deep navy system with a gold to orange gradient. One asset, instantly recognizable at any size.

projects.name: DAWN Internet
projects.scope: Brand, web, Chrome extension, app, dashboard & web development
projects.about: DAWN is a decentralized internet provider. We designed the brand and every surface of the product, the website, app, dashboard, and Chrome extension, and built the site.
projects.challenge: DAWN had a complex, technical product and needed one coherent identity across five different surfaces (marketing site, app, dashboard, and extension) that would still make sense to non-technical users.
projects.solution: A signal-wave mark and a dark, focused system applied consistently across web, app, dashboard, and extension. That consistency helped DAWN raise over $1M and grow to 1M users.
